## Work and authority
Primary work issue: ...
Author instruction/source: ...
This is an agent-prepared PR, not a human approval. One PR for this response.

## Changes and disclosure
Exact scope and artifacts; source classification; applicable disclosure permission. No private source payload or PR-01 leakage in descriptions, tests or logs.

## Verification
Commands actually run, tested version, results and limitations. State when CI or human review has not run; do not invent approval.

## Blockers
Blocked by: #ISSUE (affected stage and resolution condition), or none after live review.
Human acceptance deferred to: ...

## Completion
Use `Closes #N` only when all of work issue N is complete. For partial work use `Refs #N` and leave it open. Never auto-close a human gate. Merge only after required checks, valid scope and source permissions are confirmed for the inspected head SHA. Record the actual merge result afterward. No auto-release.
